name: Kanekoda Yumi
source:
Assistant to boss and mostly in charge of office. Doesn't like security guards jobs think its a waste of money an especially dislikes protagonist. Tries to get him fired by hiring another security guard and holding a vote at end of month of who stays. Has past history of not getting along with tokiko so tends to treat her coldly. 

[spoiler] Has dark nipples and vagina that she is secretly embarrassed about, uses special cream to make them lighter. [spoiler]
